scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && node scripts/check-type-escapes.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test && node --test test/live/redact.test.ts test/live/gas.test.ts test/live/retry.test.ts test/live/mode.test.ts test/live/rpc-proxy.test.ts test/live/anvil.test.ts test/live/matrix.test.ts test/live/lock.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test:unit
scripts.test:localstack: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter hardhat-kms-aws run test:localstack
scripts.test:examples: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter hardhat-kms-aws run test:examples
scripts.test:live:aws: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter hardhat-kms-aws run test:live:aws
scripts.test:live:azure: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter hardhat-kms-azure run test:live:azure
scripts.test:live:gcp: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter hardhat-kms-gcp run test:live:gcp
scripts.coverage: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run coverage
scripts.pkg:check: pnpm run build && node scripts/check-packages.ts && knip
scripts.release: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && changeset publish
